description: physics.derailment new: an EU07 without a driver runs at 150 km/h into a curve of R 300 m without cant, a track of 150 m laid on its own in the fields of td.scn (autotest_curve), on level ground (the grass of td.scn). Over its overturning speed (about 120 km/h) it overturns out of the curve: it slides on the grass out of the curve, falls on its side and stops.
needs_models: the derailed EU07 slides over the level ground of the fragment's triangles, which a run without the assets leaves out
